scope: Actual session/config JavaScript in bounded DOM and music-controller fixtures
checks: joining is opaque before engine creation and ordinary socket/acceptance do not reveal it
room requires both actual readiness and a rendered frame
loading invalidates previous room/game readiness, including mode transition gap
autohost redirect re-covers and socket-open cannot hide joining cover
profile is saved before native start and invalid names cannot start an engine
Java Back cache is updated synchronously before native start and teardown, then cleared on pagehide
terminal error keeps full reason and app return tears down the engine
native leaving covers before teardown and never reveals stock frontend
repeated leaving frames cannot postpone return forever
pre-acceptance endpoint close leaves time for native fallback
native kick after socket close retains terminal multiline reason
power HUD uses actual native integers and updates spending, income and queued reservations
power HUD hides missing/fractional state and avoids footer/radar overlap
header shows only actual visible native timer and connection text and clears stale status
native status mount precedes Lobby and has bounded shrinking text without resizing the button
config seeds stock HUD settings and saved name without losing unrelated options
removed Home and Help nodes have no session lookup or command wiring
header Combat toggles persistent lock exactly once and leaves All Units as its own action
Combat highlight follows confirmed native state, including suspension and phase resets
command/page/build transitions and periodic chrome synchronization refresh Combat lock
native activation precedes music-token read and iframe URL, with a distinct token for the next join
invalid player names do not mint/read a music token or create an engine
Music commands are available only after an actual rendered game
soundtrack battle-active follows rendered game readiness and suspends in loading/room
Music opens the compact shared menu in the parent document and the second header press closes it
every non-music command closes the soundtrack menu without using native hotkeys
return and pagehide dispose soundtrack players and revoke native session before another game
native leaving and terminal join errors stop music before the delayed teardown
unavailable music controller stays recoverable and cannot change Combat or All Units
Music header/scripts and stock music-disable setting are isolated to Multiplayer
